changes.summary: Gemini native Chat Completions tools and grounding/URL metadata survive JSON and streaming requests without bypassing stream-event hooks.
Provider-executed tools bypass response caches; unsupported cross-protocol translation is rejected rather than silently dropping tools.
Native upgrade and recovery acceptance includes the published v2.11.7, v2.12.0 and v2.12.1 baselines.
Native lifecycle fixtures disable background release discovery before first boot, preserving strict configuration-drift rejection and customer defaults.
Opaque Gemini function-call thought signatures survive Chat Completions JSON, SSE and next-turn history, with parallel index/ID correlation and late-signature draining.
